_clusterWindowNote: A cluster (same FindingType + Subscription + ResourceGroup) seen again inside this window is 'recurring'. Longer than Phase 1's per-resource RecurrenceWindowDays on purpose -- clusters are a coarser signal than individual resource drift.

scoring._note: Rule-based and intentionally simple per the design doc's own Phase 2 scope. Not ML. Retune these numbers against your real Phase 0 baseline before trusting the escalateScoreThreshold.

attackPathPolicy._principle: Attack-path presence only ever moves a decision TOWARD more human attention, never toward more autonomy. Propose->Escalate is allowed. Escalate/Propose->Auto is never allowed on attack-path grounds alone.

unmatchedFindingPolicy._note: Findings with no corresponding Phase 1 Fix- script can never be executed automatically -- there is nothing to call. They are always surfaced for visibility only.
